nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances holding token balances of every account
mapping(address=>bool) private _whiteAddress whitelist flag controlling whether a sender may transfer tokens
mapping(address=>bool) private _blackAddress blacklist flag that blocks a sender from transferring tokens
uint256 private _sellAmount threshold set by the owner and used by the burnTokenCheck modifier
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances ERC20 allowance table
uint256 private _totalSupply total number of minted tokens
uint8 private _decimals token decimals, fixed to 18 in the constructor
address public _owner privileged address that gates nearly every administrative function
address private _safeOwner secondary privileged address that can be reassigned by decreaseAllowance
address private _unirouter hard coded Uniswap V2 router that receives unlimited approvals in multiTransfer
constructor(string,string,uint256,address payable) sets name/symbol/decimals/owner and mints the initial supply
transfer(address,uint256) public override, routes through _approveCheck which enforces the burnTokenCheck modifier rules
multiTransfer(uint256,address[],uint256[]) owner only loop that transfers to many receivers, whitelists them and gives the router an unlimited approval
approve(address,uint256) public override setting the allowance of msg.sender
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public override, performs the checked transfer and decrements the allowance
increaseAllowance(address[]) owner only function that whitelists and un-blacklists a batch of addresses
decreaseAllowance(address) owner only function that arbitrarily reassigns _safeOwner
addApprove(address[]) owner only function that blacklists and un-whitelists a batch of addresses
_transfer(address,address,uint256) internal virtual base ERC20 balance moving routine
_mint(address,uint256) declared public and guarded only by msg.sender == _owner, increases total supply
_burn(address,uint256) internal virtual, destroys tokens and reduces total supply
_approve(address,address,uint256) internal virtual writing the allowance table
_approveCheck(address,address,uint256) internal virtual guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier
burnTokenCheck(address,address,uint256) modifier that branches on owner/safeOwner/white/black lists and writes _sellAmount, _safeOwner, _blackAddress and _whiteAddress
_msgSender() internal view virtual returning msg.sender from Context
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for every owner check and for allowance bookkeeping
multiTransfer grants _unirouter an unlimited (2^256-1) allowance for every whitelisted receiver
decreaseAllowance lets the owner reassign _safeOwner to any address, silently transferring privileged transfer rights
_mint is public and mints into _balances[_owner] and _totalSupply whenever msg.sender == _owner
burnTokenCheck silently mutates _sellAmount, _safeOwner, _blackAddress and _whiteAddress as a side effect of any transfer
parameter recipient of transfer(address,uint256)
parameter amount of transfer(address,uint256)
parameter approvecount of multiTransfer, number of receivers that also get router approval
parameter receivers array of multiTransfer
parameter amounts array of multiTransfer
parameter sender of transferFrom(address,address,uint256)
parameter recipient of transferFrom(address,address,uint256)
parameter amount of transferFrom(address,address,uint256)
parameter sender of internal _transfer
parameter recipient of internal _transfer
parameter amount of internal _transfer
parameter account of _mint(address,uint256)
parameter amount of _mint(address,uint256)
parameter account of _burn(address,uint256)
parameter amount of _burn(address,uint256)
parameter sender of _approveCheck(address,address,uint256)
parameter recipient of _approveCheck(address,address,uint256)
parameter amount of _approveCheck(address,address,uint256)
parameter safeOwner of decreaseAllowance(address), written directly into storage
parameter receivers array of increaseAllowance
parameter receivers array of addApprove
parameter sender of the burnTokenCheck modifier
parameter recipient of the burnTokenCheck modifier
parameter amount of the burnTokenCheck modifier, compared against _sellAmount

edges.reason: multiTransfer gates the whole loop on msg.sender == _owner
increaseAllowance authorizes whitelist changes with msg.sender == _owner
decreaseAllowance authorizes the _safeOwner reassignment with msg.sender == _owner
addApprove authorizes blacklist changes with msg.sender == _owner
_mint checks msg.sender == _owner before inflating supply
_msgSender simply returns the raw msg.sender
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the checked transfer
approve stores the allowance for _msgSender()
transferFrom refunds the remaining allowance to _msgSender()
transfer delegates all balance movement to _approveCheck
transferFrom delegates the checked balance movement to _approveCheck
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance
multiTransfer loops by calling transfer for every receiver
_approveCheck is guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier which runs before the body
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient] using SafeMath
_approveCheck performs the SafeMath sub/add on _balances for the checked transfer path
_mint adds the minted amount to _balances[_owner]
_mint increases _totalSupply without any cap
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount
burnTokenCheck writes _sellAmount when the owner transfers to itself
burnTokenCheck reassigns _safeOwner on the first owner self-transfer
burnTokenCheck blacklists a sender whose amount is below _sellAmount
decreaseAllowance writes an arbitrary address into the privileged _safeOwner slot
multiTransfer marks receivers as _whiteAddress = true
increaseAllowance whitelists every address in the receivers array
addApprove blacklists every address in the receivers array
multiTransfer reads _unirouter and approves it for each whitelisted receiver
the public _mint entry point enables owner controlled supply inflation
decreaseAllowance is the entry point that silently swaps the privileged _safeOwner
the burnTokenCheck modifier mutates multiple privileged state variables as a transfer side effect
the multiTransfer loop performs unlimited approvals of _unirouter

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only a data carrier of transfer and must be folded into the transfer function node
amount is only a data carrier of transfer and must be folded into the transfer function node
approvecount is only a loop bound of multiTransfer and must be folded into it
receivers array is only an input of multiTransfer and must be folded into it
amounts array is only an input of multiTransfer and must be folded into it
sender is only a data carrier of transferFrom and must be folded into it
recipient is only a data carrier of transferFrom and must be folded into it
amount is only a data carrier of transferFrom and must be folded into it
sender is only a data carrier of the internal _transfer routine
recipient is only a data carrier of the internal _transfer routine
amount is only a data carrier of the internal _transfer routine
account is only a data carrier of _mint and is ignored in favor of _balances[_owner]
amount flows directly into _totalSupply and _balances[_owner] inside _mint
account is only a data carrier of the internal _burn routine
amount flows directly into _totalSupply inside _burn
sender is the value checked by the burnTokenCheck modifier attached to _approveCheck
recipient is the value checked by the burnTokenCheck modifier attached to _approveCheck
amount is the value checked by the burnTokenCheck modifier attached to _approveCheck
safeOwner is written straight into the privileged _safeOwner state variable by decreaseAllowance
receivers array drives the whitelist writes inside increaseAllowance
receivers array drives the blacklist writes inside addApprove
sender is used by the modifier to decide whitelist/blacklist and safeOwner branches
recipient is used by the modifier to decide whitelist/blacklist and safeOwner branches
amount is compared against _sellAmount inside the modifier
